summary: Vox Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing the results of its Annual and Special Meeting of shareholders. The filing reports that all five director nominees were elected, auditors were appointed, and the 2026 Omnibus Long-Term Incentive Plan was adopted. Vote percentages are provided for each nominee, ranging from 78.4% to 96.1% in favor. The meeting was routine; no special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, etc.) is disclosed. This is a standard periodic report of voting results with no extraordinary corporate action.
